text: 长江证券研报指出，中国建筑营收收缩拖累盈利，每股稳定分红提供安全边际。公司2026Q1-Q3归属净利润287.14 亿元，同比减少24.81%；单3季度营业收入3598.74亿元，同比减少20.02%。毛利率同比回升，但营收收缩、费用率及所得税负担上升影响盈利。前三季度经营现金流同比改善，单三季度净流出扩大。工业厂房、数据中心成为房建增长亮点，海外订单及营收持续增长。公司境外新签合同2811 亿元，同比增长66.9%，公司在东南亚、北非、西亚等重点区域市场承接科威特北卡巴德污水处理厂及配套项目、阿联酋阿布扎比至迪拜高铁阿布扎比段等重大工程，并在印尼、马来
text_en: A Changjiang Securities research report pointed out that China State Construction Engineering's revenue contraction dragged down profit, while stable per-share dividends provide a margin of safety. The company's net profit attributable to shareholders for Q1-Q3 2026 was 28.714 billion yuan, down 24.81% year on year; third-quarter revenue alone was 359.874 billion yuan, down 20.02% year on year. The gross margin rebounded year on year, but revenue contraction and higher expense ratios and income tax burden weighed on profit. Operating cash flow improved year on year in the first three quarters, while net outflow expanded in the third quarter alone. Industrial plants and data centers became growth highlights in housing construction, and overseas orders and revenue continued to grow. The company's newly signed overseas contracts amounted to 281.1 billion yuan, up 66.9% year on year.
